webhooks.name: mappwrapper.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Registers mutating (defaults on create) and validating (constraints on create/update) admission webhooks for AppWrapper resources. The webhook performs SubjectAccessReview checks to verify the submitting user is authorized to create the underlying wrapped resources, and lists CustomResourceDefinitions to validate that the wrapped resource types exist.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.ray.openshift.ai
webhooks.purpose: Mutates RayCluster resources on create/update to inject an OAuth proxy sidecar container (with TLS volume and dedicated service account) and mTLS init containers (with CA volumes, certificate volume mounts, and TLS environment variables) into head and worker pods, then validates that these injected resources are not tampered with and that ingress is not enabled.

webhooks.name: vappwrapper.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Registers mutating (defaults on create) and validating (constraints on create/update) admission webhooks for AppWrapper resources. The webhook performs SubjectAccessReview checks to verify the submitting user is authorized to create the underlying wrapped resources, and lists CustomResourceDefinitions to validate that the wrapped resource types exist.

webhooks.name: vraycluster.ray.openshift.ai
webhooks.purpose: Mutates RayCluster resources on create/update to inject an OAuth proxy sidecar container (with TLS volume and dedicated service account) and mTLS init containers (with CA volumes, certificate volume mounts, and TLS environment variables) into head and worker pods, then validates that these injected resources are not tampered with and that ingress is not enabled.

webhooks.name: InferenceGraphValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceGraph resources on create and update by enforcing naming conventions (lowercase alphanumeric with dashes), requiring a 'root' node, ensuring step names are unique within each node, verifying each step specifies exactly one inference target (nodeName, serviceName, or serviceURL), and checking that splitter nodes have weights summing to 100.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceDefaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets defaults on InferenceService resources during create/update, including deployment mode normalization, resource requirement defaults, runtime selection based on ML framework (SKLearn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Triton, etc.), protocol version defaults, security settings (disabling automount of service account tokens), and local model cache label/annotation assignment by matching the predictor's storageUri against cluster-scoped LocalModelCache and namespace-scoped LocalModelNamespaceCache entries.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceService resources on create and update by enforcing naming conventions, autoscaler configuration, blocked environment variables, multi-node worker spec constraints (GPU types, storage URI protocols, parallel sizes), autoscaling metric/target rules for HPA/KPA/KEDA, storage URI path validity, and prevents deployment mode changes after initial deployment.

webhooks.name: LocalModelCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it enforces that no two LocalModelCache objects share the same storageURI. On delete, it prevents removal if any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService still references the LocalModelCache via the local-model label.

webhooks.name: LocalModelNamespaceCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelNamespaceCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it ensures all referenced node groups exist. On delete, it prevents removal if the cache is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService that carries matching local-model labels.

webhooks.name: TrainedModelValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainedModel resources on create and update, ensuring the model name matches an alphanumeric/underscore/dash pattern, the storageURI uses a supported protocol prefix, and the memory specification is not modified after initial creation.

webhooks.name: clusterservingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to ensure model format priorities are consistent and non-conflicting across runtimes, and that multi-node WorkerSpec configurations (pipeline/tensor parallel sizes, GPU types, container counts, blocked env vars) are valid.

webhooks.name: inferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.pod-mutator
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Pod creation for KServe-managed pods (those labeled with an InferenceService identifier). It injects storage initializer init-containers for model downloading, credential volumes/env-vars for accessing model storage, inference logger/batcher agent sidecars, metrics aggregator configuration, GKE accelerator node selectors, and optionally modelcar (OCI image) support.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on LLMInferenceService resources and attaches local model cache labels/annotations by matching the service's model URI against existing LocalModelNamespaceCache (namespace-scoped, higher priority) and LocalModelCache (cluster-scoped) resources, enabling local PVC-backed model serving when the local model feature is enabled in the InferenceService ConfigMap.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha1 that enforces structural and cross-field constraints on create and update: router/gateway and HTTPRoute ref-vs-spec mutual exclusivity, parallelism configuration rules (worker requires parallelism, pipeline and data parallelism are mutually exclusive, data and dataLocal must be paired), scheduler replica and config validity, workload scaling rules (delegated to v1alpha2), and immutability of total parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on LLMInferenceService resources and attaches local model cache labels/annotations by matching the service's model URI against existing LocalModelNamespaceCache (namespace-scoped, higher priority) and LocalModelCache (cluster-scoped) resources, enabling local PVC-backed model serving when the local model feature is enabled in the InferenceService ConfigMap.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha2 resources on create and update. Enforces business rules including router/HTTPRoute/gateway cross-field consistency, parallelism constraints (pipeline vs data parallelism mutual exclusivity, worker requires parallelism), immutability of total parallelism size on updates, scheduler config validity (inline vs ref, replicas > 0), LoRA adapter naming rules (uniqueness, no path traversal, differs from base model), and autoscaling constraints (replicas vs scaling mutual exclusivity, min/max replica bounds, HPA/KEDA mutual exclusivity, WVA variantCost format, KEDA controller-owned field restrictions, idleReplicaCount < minReplicas, and decode/prefill actuator backend consistency).

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create and update, rejecting specs that include the forbidden baseRefs field or invalid scheduler replicas (must be > 0), and emitting warnings when well-known configs are modified or deleted.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create and update by forbidding the baseRefs field (recursive refs are disabled), ensuring scheduler replicas are greater than zero, running optional injected validation logic, and emitting warnings when well-known configs are modified or deleted.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to ensure model format priorities are consistent and non-conflicting across runtimes, and that multi-node WorkerSpec configurations (pipeline/tensor parallel sizes, GPU types, container counts, blocked env vars) are valid.

webhooks.name: InferenceGraphValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceGraph resources on create and update by enforcing naming conventions (lowercase alphanumeric/hyphens starting with a letter), requiring a 'root' node, ensuring step names are unique within each node, verifying each step specifies exactly one inference target (nodeName, serviceName, or serviceURL), and checking that splitter-type nodes have traffic weights summing to 100.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceDefaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets defaults on InferenceService objects at create/update time. It reads cluster configuration to apply default resource requests/limits, deployment mode, runtime selection (e.g. SKLearn, TensorFlow, Triton), protocol versions, security settings (disabling automount of service-account tokens), and local-model PVC labels/annotations by matching the predictor's storageUri against LocalModelCache and LocalModelNamespaceCache resources.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Non-mutating validating webhook for InferenceService resources on create and update. Enforces naming conventions, autoscaler configuration, blocked environment variables, multi-node (workerSpec) constraints, deployment-mode immutability, predictor name immutability, canary traffic/spec rules, storageURI validity, confidential-serving requirements, and per-component (predictor/transformer/explainer) scaling and implementation correctness — all via in-memory checks on the submitted object without fetching any external resources.

webhooks.name: LocalModelCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it enforces that no two LocalModelCache resources share the same storageURI. On delete, it prevents removal of a LocalModelCache that is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService (checked via the local-model label).

webhooks.name: LocalModelNamespaceCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelNamespaceCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it ensures all referenced node groups exist. On delete, it prevents removal if the cache is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService that carries matching local-model labels.

webhooks.name: TrainedModelValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainedModel resources on create and update, ensuring the resource name matches an alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen pattern, the storageURI uses a supported protocol prefix, and the memory specification is not modified after initial creation.

webhooks.name: clusterservingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to enforce model format priority uniqueness across runtimes sharing the same protocol, consistency of priorities within a single runtime, multi-node WorkerSpec constraints (no removal of existing WorkerSpec, single container limit, valid GPU types, pipeline/tensor parallel size bounds), and blocked environment variables.

webhooks.name: inferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.pod-mutator
webhooks.purpose: Mutates pods belonging to InferenceServices on creation by injecting storage initializer init-containers (with credentials for model download), inference logger/batcher agent sidecars, metrics aggregator sidecars, and GKE GPU node-selector tolerations. It reads the global KServe config, the owning InferenceService, and credential secrets to assemble the correct container specs and volume mounts before the pod is admitted.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources on create/update, then matches the resource's model URI against LocalModelNamespaceCache (namespace-scoped, higher priority) and LocalModelCache (cluster-scoped) entries to set labels and annotations linking the service to a local model cache PVC for node-local model serving.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha1 that enforces structural and cross-field constraints on create and update: mutual exclusivity of HTTPRoute refs vs inline spec and managed vs custom gateway routing, traffic-splitting field consistency (group/weight pairing and Gateway API requirement), parallelism invariants (worker requires parallelism, pipeline/data exclusivity, data/dataLocal co-requirement, positive values), scheduler config validity (replicas > 0, inline-or-ref but not both), scaling rules (delegated to the v1alpha2 hub validators), and immutability of total parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources on create/update, then matches the resource's model URI against LocalModelNamespaceCache (namespace-scoped, higher priority) and LocalModelCache (cluster-scoped) entries to set labels and annotations linking the service to a local model cache PVC for node-local model serving.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha2 that enforces structural and cross-field constraints on create and update: router/gateway/HTTPRoute consistency, parallelism configuration (pipeline vs data, immutability of total size), scheduler config (inline vs ref, replicas), autoscaling rules (HPA/KEDA mutual exclusivity, actuator consistency across decode/prefill, WVA variant-cost format, idle-replica bounds), LoRA adapter uniqueness and naming, KV-cache offloading tier completeness, managed DRA annotation validity, traffic-splitting prerequisites, and confidential model spec correctness.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create, update, and delete. It forbids the baseRefs field (disabling recursive config references), ensures scheduler replicas are greater than zero, runs optional injected validation logic, and emits warnings or blocks deletion of well-known (built-in) configs.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create, update, and delete. It forbids the baseRefs field (disabling recursive refs), enforces that scheduler replicas are positive, runs optional injected validation logic, and emits warnings or blocks deletion of well-known configs in the KServe namespace.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to enforce model format priority uniqueness across runtimes sharing the same protocol, consistency of priorities within a single runtime, multi-node WorkerSpec constraints (no removal of existing WorkerSpec, single container limit, valid GPU types, pipeline/tensor parallel size bounds), and blocked environment variables.

webhooks.name: notebooks-validation.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates Notebook updates to prevent removal of the MLflow instance annotation while the notebook is running, because removing it deletes the RoleBinding immediately while environment variables persist until pod restart, creating a broken state where the MLflow client has credentials but no permissions.

webhooks.name: notebooks.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for Kubeflow Notebook CRs on create and update. It injects a reconciliation lock annotation on creation, resolves container images from OpenShift ImageStreams, mounts trusted CA certificate bundles, injects a kube-rbac-proxy authentication sidecar, mounts pipeline runtime image ConfigMaps and Elyra DSP secrets for Data Science Pipelines integration, injects cluster-wide proxy environment variables, sets MLflow tracking environment variables, mounts Feast configuration, and blocks pod-template-changing mutations on running notebooks to prevent unintended restarts (marking them as update-pending instead).

webhooks.name: mraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that enforces OpenShift-specific defaults on RayCluster resources: on OpenShift clusters it enables the secure trusted network annotation and forces EnableIngress to false so that all external access goes through Gateway API authentication; on non-OpenShift clusters it disables the secure trusted network annotation.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that enforces OpenShift-specific defaults on RayCluster resources: on OpenShift clusters it enables the secure trusted network annotation and forces EnableIngress to false so that all external access goes through Gateway API authentication; on non-OpenShift clusters it disables the secure trusted network annotation.

webhooks.name: vraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates RayCluster resources on create and update by checking that the cluster metadata name is valid (via ValidateRayClusterMetadata) and that all worker group names within the spec are unique, rejecting the request if either constraint is violated.

webhooks.name: vrayjob.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for RayJob resources that rejects create and update requests whose metadata (specifically the object name) fails RayJob-specific naming rules enforced by ValidateRayJobMetadata. Delete requests are always allowed without validation.

webhooks.name: vrayservice.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for RayService resources that rejects create and update requests whose metadata (specifically the object name) fails RayService-specific validation rules, ensuring service names conform to required conventions before the resource is persisted.

webhooks.name: ClusterQueueWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for Kueue ClusterQueue resources. The defaulter adds a ResourceInUse finalizer on creation, while the validator enforces correctness of resource groups (no duplicate resources or flavors, non-negative quantities, matching covered resource names), borrowing/lending limits (must be nil when no cohort, lending limit must not exceed nominal quota), namespace selectors, admission check configuration exclusivity, preemption policy consistency, and fair sharing settings.

webhooks.name: ClusterQueueWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for Kueue ClusterQueue resources. The defaulter adds a ResourceInUse finalizer on creation, while the validator enforces correctness of resource groups (no duplicate resources or flavors, non-negative quantities, matching covered resource names), borrowing/lending limits (must be nil when no cohort, lending limit must not exceed nominal quota), namespace selectors, admission check configuration exclusivity, preemption policy consistency, and fair sharing settings.

webhooks.name: JobSetWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for JobSet resources (jobset.x-k8s.io/v1alpha2). The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (based on queue name or namespace selector), and sets the managedBy field to MultiKueue when the associated ClusterQueue has a MultiKueue admission check. The validating webhook enforces Kueue-specific constraints on create and update, including queue-name immutability and topology-aware scheduling pod-set annotation validation on each replicated job template.

webhooks.name: JobSetWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for JobSet resources (jobset.x-k8s.io/v1alpha2). The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (based on queue name or namespace selector), and sets the managedBy field to MultiKueue when the associated ClusterQueue has a MultiKueue admission check. The validating webhook enforces Kueue-specific constraints on create and update, including queue-name immutability and topology-aware scheduling pod-set annotation validation on each replicated job template.

webhooks.name: JobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for batch/v1 Jobs. The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the managedBy field for MultiKueue. The validating webhook enforces constraints on partial admission (minParallelism annotation range), sync-completion (completions must equal parallelism for indexed jobs), immutability of parallelism while unsuspended with partial admission, and topology-aware scheduling pod set requests.

webhooks.name: JobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for batch/v1 Jobs. The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the managedBy field for MultiKueue. The validating webhook enforces constraints on partial admission (minParallelism annotation range), sync-completion (completions must equal parallelism for indexed jobs), immutability of parallelism while unsuspended with partial admission, and topology-aware scheduling pod set requests.

webhooks.name: MpiJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Provides mutating and validating admission webhooks for Kubeflow MPIJob resources to integrate them with Kueue's job queuing system. The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the managedBy field for MultiKueue; the validating webhook enforces queue-name constraints on create/update and validates Topology-Aware Scheduling annotations on replica pod templates.

webhooks.name: MpiJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Provides mutating and validating admission webhooks for Kubeflow MPIJob resources to integrate them with Kueue's job queuing system. The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the managedBy field for MultiKueue; the validating webhook enforces queue-name constraints on create/update and validates Topology-Aware Scheduling annotations on replica pod templates.

webhooks.name: Pod-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Manages standalone Pods for Kueue admission control. The mutating webhook gates (suspends) pods that should be managed by Kueue based on namespace selectors, pod selectors, queue-name labels, and owner-chain inspection, adding a finalizer, the managed-by-kueue label, scheduling gates, and role-hash annotations for pod groups. The validating webhook enforces that the managed label value is correct, pod-group metadata (group name and total count) is consistent, topology-aware scheduling annotations are valid, prebuilt workload names match group names, group names are immutable on update, and retriable-in-group annotations cannot be reverted.

data_read.group: (dynamic: walks owner-reference chain to detect whether an ancestor job is already managed by Kueue)

webhooks.name: PodWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Manages standalone Pods for Kueue admission control. The mutating webhook gates (suspends) pods that should be managed by Kueue based on namespace selectors, pod selectors, queue-name labels, and owner-chain inspection, adding a finalizer, the managed-by-kueue label, scheduling gates, and role-hash annotations for pod groups. The validating webhook enforces that the managed label value is correct, pod-group metadata (group name and total count) is consistent, topology-aware scheduling annotations are valid, prebuilt workload names match group names, group names are immutable on update, and retriable-in-group annotations cannot be reverted.

data_read.group: (dynamic: walks owner-reference chain to detect whether an ancestor job is already managed by Kueue)

webhooks.name: RayClusterWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for KubeRay RayCluster resources managed by Kueue. The mutating webhook applies default local queue names, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (by checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the default managedBy field. The validating webhook enforces that Kueue-managed RayClusters do not use in-tree autoscaling, limits worker groups to at most 7, forbids the reserved group name 'head' for workers, and validates topology-aware scheduling requests.

webhooks.name: RayClusterWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for KubeRay RayCluster resources managed by Kueue. The mutating webhook applies default local queue names, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (by checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the default managedBy field. The validating webhook enforces that Kueue-managed RayClusters do not use in-tree autoscaling, limits worker groups to at most 7, forbids the reserved group name 'head' for workers, and validates topology-aware scheduling requests.

webhooks.name: RayJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Defaults and validates KubeRay RayJob resources for Kueue queue-based admission control. During defaulting it assigns a default local queue, suspends the job so Kueue can control admission, and sets the managedBy field; during validation it enforces that Kueue-managed RayJobs shut down their cluster after finishing, do not reference existing clusters or use autoscaling, have at most 7 worker groups with none named "head", and carry valid topology-aware scheduling annotations.

webhooks.name: RayJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Defaults and validates KubeRay RayJob resources for Kueue queue-based admission control. During defaulting it assigns a default local queue, suspends the job so Kueue can control admission, and sets the managedBy field; during validation it enforces that Kueue-managed RayJobs shut down their cluster after finishing, do not reference existing clusters or use autoscaling, have at most 7 worker groups with none named "head", and carry valid topology-aware scheduling annotations.

webhooks.name: ResourceFlavorWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates and defaults Kueue ResourceFlavor objects. On creation, it adds a ResourceInUse finalizer to prevent premature deletion. On create and update, it validates that nodeLabels are valid Kubernetes labels, nodeTaints have valid keys/values and are unique by key+effect, and tolerations are well-formed.

webhooks.name: ResourceFlavorWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates and defaults Kueue ResourceFlavor objects. On creation, it adds a ResourceInUse finalizer to prevent premature deletion. On create and update, it validates that nodeLabels are valid Kubernetes labels, nodeTaints have valid keys/values and are unique by key+effect, and tolerations are well-formed.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for apps/v1 StatefulSet resources managed by Kueue. The defaulter propagates queue-name labels and pod-group annotations into the pod template and marks pods as suspended-by-parent when Kueue should manage the workload; the validator ensures the queue-name is valid on create, and on update enforces immutability of queue-name (when ready replicas exist or queue-name is removed), priority class, pod spec, and replica count (only allowing scale to/from zero).

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for apps/v1 StatefulSet resources managed by Kueue. The defaulter propagates queue-name labels and pod-group annotations into the pod template and marks pods as suspended-by-parent when Kueue should manage the workload; the validator ensures the queue-name is valid on create, and on update enforces immutability of queue-name (when ready replicas exist or queue-name is removed), priority class, pod spec, and replica count (only allowing scale to/from zero).

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for apps/v1 Deployments managed by Kueue. The mutating webhook propagates queue-name labels, applies default local queue, and suspends workloads by annotating the pod template when the Deployment should be managed by Kueue (based on queue-name presence, ancestor ownership, and namespace selector). The validating webhook ensures queue-name label validity on create, and on update prevents queue-name changes while pods are running or if the queue-name is being removed, and enforces immutability of the workload priority class.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Implements mutating and validating admission webhooks for LeaderWorkerSet resources. The defaulter suspends LeaderWorkerSets that should be managed by Kueue (annotating pod templates for pod-level integration and propagating priority class labels), while the validator enforces queue name validity, topology-aware scheduling annotations, and immutability of queue name, priority class, and pod template specs on updates.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for apps/v1 Deployments managed by Kueue. The mutating webhook propagates queue-name labels, applies default local queue, and suspends workloads by annotating the pod template when the Deployment should be managed by Kueue (based on queue-name presence, ancestor ownership, and namespace selector). The validating webhook ensures queue-name label validity on create, and on update prevents queue-name changes while pods are running or if the queue-name is being removed, and enforces immutability of the workload priority class.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Implements mutating and validating admission webhooks for LeaderWorkerSet resources. The defaulter suspends LeaderWorkerSets that should be managed by Kueue (annotating pod templates for pod-level integration and propagating priority class labels), while the validator enforces queue name validity, topology-aware scheduling annotations, and immutability of queue name, priority class, and pod template specs on updates.

webhooks.name: WorkloadWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for Kueue Workload resources. The defaulter drops minCount from podSets when the PartialAdmission feature gate is disabled; the validator enforces constraints including at most one variable-count podSet, resource usage divisible by pod count, immutability of admission and podSetUpdates once set, non-decreasing reclaimable pod counts while admitted, and prohibition of the reserved 'pods' resource key in container requests.

webhooks.name: WorkloadWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for Kueue Workload resources. The defaulter drops minCount from podSets when the PartialAdmission feature gate is disabled; the validator enforces constraints including at most one variable-count podSet, resource usage divisible by pod count, immutability of admission and podSetUpdates once set, non-decreasing reclaimable pod counts while admitted, and prohibition of the reserved 'pods' resource key in container requests.

webhooks.name: vcohort.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for Cohort resources (kueue.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1) that runs on create and update operations. It validates the Cohort spec by checking fair sharing configuration and resource groups, enforcing structural correctness of these fields without requiring nominal-greater-than-lending constraints.

webhooks.name: mmodelregistry.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook defaults ModelRegistry spec fields (service route, proxy migration from OAuth to kube-rbac-proxy, image cleanup) and validating webhook enforces cluster-wide name uniqueness on create, restricts the CR namespace to the configured registries namespace, and requires at least one database (postgres or mysql) configuration.

webhooks.name: vmodelregistry.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook defaults ModelRegistry spec fields (service route, proxy migration from OAuth to kube-rbac-proxy, image cleanup) and validating webhook enforces cluster-wide name uniqueness on create, restricts the CR namespace to the configured registries namespace, and requires at least one database (postgres or mysql) configuration.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.modelmesh-webhook-server.default
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources that enforces autoscaling configuration constraints on multi-model ModelMesh runtimes, including valid autoscaler class, HPA metrics type, target utilization percentage (1-100), and consistent replica scaling settings (e.g. disallowing both static replicas and HPA, ensuring min <= max replicas).

webhooks.name: vaitenant.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for AITenant resources that enforces two invariants: AITenant CRs must be created in the configured infrastructure namespace, and each AITenant must reference a unique Gateway (no two AITenants may share the same gateway name/namespace) to guarantee tenant isolation.

webhooks.name: vmaasauthpolicy.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates MaaSAuthPolicy resources on creation by ensuring the target namespace is an authorized MaaS tenant namespace. It rejects creation if neither a MaasTenantConfig nor a legacy Tenant CR exists in the namespace, preventing auth policies from being created in uninitialized namespaces.

webhooks.name: vmaassubscription.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates MaaSSubscription creation by ensuring the target namespace is enabled for MaaS tenant resources. It rejects the request unless a MaasTenantConfig (or legacy Tenant) CR already exists in the namespace, enforcing that tenant initialization must precede subscription creation.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2). It injects ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 service accounts, OCI image pull secrets, or URI model endpoints) from annotated Secrets into the spec, and applies HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue labels) from the referenced HardwareProfile CR, with surgical cleanup on annotation removal during updates.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha2.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2). It injects ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 service accounts, OCI image pull secrets, or URI model endpoints) from annotated Secrets into the spec, and applies HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue labels) from the referenced HardwareProfile CR, with surgical cleanup on annotation removal during updates.

webhooks.name: minferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for KServe InferenceGraph v1alpha1 resources. The defaulter is a no-op placeholder, while the validator enforces that serviceURL references in graph node steps use only cluster-internal hostnames (ending in .svc or .svc.<clusterDomain>) and that those URLs target the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, preventing cross-namespace references and public hostname usage for security reasons (e.g. preventing Authorization header leaks).

webhooks.name: minferenceservice-v1beta1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that injects connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) and HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into InferenceService specs at admission time; validating webhook that rejects InferenceServices with names exceeding the length limit or targeting the protected application namespace.

webhooks.name: mutating.pod.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutates incoming Pods that have RAY_USE_TLS enabled (in kserve-container or worker-container) by injecting TLS-related volumes, volume mounts, and an init container that copies Ray TLS certificates from a shared Secret into the pod, enabling mTLS communication between Ray cluster nodes used for distributed inference serving.

webhooks.name: validating.isvc.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that injects connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) and HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into InferenceService specs at admission time; validating webhook that rejects InferenceServices with names exceeding the length limit or targeting the protected application namespace.

webhooks.name: validating.nim.account.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates NIM Account creation to enforce a singleton constraint: only one Account resource is allowed per namespace. Updates and deletions are permitted without additional validation.

webhooks.name: vinferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for KServe InferenceGraph v1alpha1 resources. The defaulter is a no-op placeholder, while the validator enforces that serviceURL references in graph node steps use only cluster-internal hostnames (ending in .svc or .svc.<clusterDomain>) and that those URLs target the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, preventing cross-namespace references and public hostname usage for security reasons (e.g. preventing Authorization header leaks).

webhooks.name: vogxserver.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for OGXServer resources on create and update. It rejects unknown distribution names (checked against an injected registry), duplicate provider IDs, model-resource references to non-existent providers, and adoption annotations whose value equals the CR name (which would cause Deployment name conflicts), while warning on deprecated distribution names.

webhooks.name: Defaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on DataScienceCluster v1 resources during create/update: when ModelRegistry is Managed and RegistriesNamespace is empty it fills in the default namespace, and when Kserve is Managed and NIM.ManagementState is empty it defaults NIM to Managed.

webhooks.name: Defaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter webhook for DataScienceCluster v2 resources. When ModelRegistry is Managed and RegistriesNamespace is empty, it sets the default registries namespace; when Kserve is Managed and NIM ManagementState is empty, it defaults NIM to Managed.

webhooks.name: Injector-webhook
webhooks.enable_condition: MonitoringServiceName component enabled OR MonitoringServiceName component enabled
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts create/update of ServiceMonitor and PodMonitor resources (monitoring.coreos.com/v1). For resources in namespaces labeled for ODH monitoring, it verifies that the cluster-scoped Monitoring CR exists (confirming monitoring is enabled) and then injects the monitoring.opendatahub.io/scrape=true label onto the monitor resource if not already set, enabling Prometheus to discover it.

webhooks.name: Injector-webhook
webhooks.enable_condition: Kserve component enabled OR Workbenches component enabled
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts create/update operations on supported workloads (Notebooks, InferenceServices, LLMInferenceServices) and injects hardware profile settings--resource requests/limits, nodeSelector, and tolerations--from a referenced HardwareProfile CR specified via annotations. It also handles profile switching (clearing old settings before applying new ones) and profile removal (cleaning up previously injected settings).

webhooks.name: NotebookWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook for Kubeflow Notebook CRs that validates and injects platform connection secrets. On create/update, it parses the 'opendatahub.io/connections' annotation (a comma-separated list of namespace/name secret references), verifies each referenced Secret exists and that the requesting user has RBAC permission to 'get' it (via SubjectAccessReview), then patches the notebook's first container envFrom to add or remove secretRef entries accordingly.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DataScienceCluster v2 create and update requests: enforces a singleton constraint (denies creation if one already exists), rejects Kueue with ManagementState set to Managed, and emits a deprecation warning when the kserve.modelsAsService field is Managed.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for DataScienceCluster v1 resources that enforces singleton creation (only one DSC instance allowed), denies setting Kueue managementState to Managed, warns when the deprecated kserve.modelsAsService field is Managed, and on updates blocks v1 API modifications when v2-only components are currently Managed to prevent silent data loss during v1-to-v2 conversion.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DSCInitialization v1 resources: enforces singleton (only one instance allowed) on create, validates PEM format of customCABundle when TrustedCABundle is Managed on create/update, and prevents deletion while any DataScienceCluster object still exists.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DSCInitialization v2 resources by enforcing singleton creation (only one instance allowed), validating PEM format of customCABundle when TrustedCABundle is managed, and preventing deletion while a DataScienceCluster object still exists.

webhooks.name: mutate-pod.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts Pod creation requests and defaults Spark driver/executor pods by looking up their owning SparkApplication and injecting spec fields (volumes, env vars, config maps, ports, affinity, tolerations, node selectors, security contexts, GPU resources, sidecars, init containers, owner references, memory limits, etc.) from the SparkApplication CR onto the pod.

webhooks.name: mutate-scheduledsparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that sets default values on ScheduledSparkApplication resources during create and update operations. Currently a no-op placeholder that logs the mutation attempt; concrete defaulting logic is planned for a future PR.

webhooks.name: mutate-sparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: A mutating admission webhook that sets default values on SparkApplication resources during create and update operations. It only applies defaults when the application is in a 'New' or 'Invalidating' state, using the operator's registered scheme defaulting functions to populate unset fields with their default values.

webhooks.name: mutate-sparkconnect.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default field values on SparkConnect resources during create and update operations. It applies the operator's registered scheme defaults (via operatorscheme.WebhookScheme.Default) to ensure all required fields have sensible values before the resource is persisted.

webhooks.name: validate-scheduledsparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook that rejects invalid ScheduledSparkApplication resources on create and update. It ensures the metadata name is a valid DNS-1035 label (preventing downstream Service creation failures) and validates the embedded SparkConf configuration; on updates it short-circuits validation when the spec is unchanged.

webhooks.name: validate-sparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for SparkApplication resources on create and update. It enforces that the app name is a valid DNS-1035 label (preventing downstream Service creation failures), validates Spark version compatibility for pod template features (requires 3.0.0+), rejects conflicting NodeSelector definitions at both app and driver/executor levels, checks for duplicate DriverIngressOptions, validates SparkConf, and optionally enforces that the app's resource requests fit within the namespace's ResourceQuotas.

webhooks.name: validate-sparkconnect.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates SparkConnect custom resources on create and update to ensure spec correctness before the controller processes them. Checks include DNS-1035 name compliance (accounting for the derived '-server' Service name), required sparkVersion (with 3.0.0+ enforcement for pod templates), container image availability, dynamic allocation bounds consistency, memory string format validation, and denial of operator-managed sparkConf keys.

webhooks.name: ClusterTrainingRuntimeWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates ClusterTrainingRuntime resources on create and update by checking that replicated job specifications are well-formed, and emits a deprecation warning on create if the runtime carries a deprecated label.

webhooks.name: TrainJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for TrainJob resources that intercepts create and update requests. It resolves the TrainJob's RuntimeRef to a registered runtime implementation and delegates validation to that runtime's ValidateObjects method, rejecting requests that reference unsupported runtimes.

webhooks.name: TrainingRuntimeWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainingRuntime resources on create to ensure that replicated jobs marked as ancestors (trainer, model-initializer, dataset-initializer) always have exactly 1 replica and contain the required container name for their ancestor type (e.g., 'node' for trainer, 'model-initializer' for model-initializer).

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for TFJob resources that enforces naming conventions (DNS-1035 labels), RunPolicy validity, and TFReplicaSpecs structure on create and update. It ensures each replica type has at least one container with a specified image and the default 'tensorflow' container name, and forbids defining more than one Chief or Master role.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for XGBoostJob resources that enforces structural constraints on create and update: ensures the job name is a valid DNS-1035 label, requires a Master replica type with exactly 1 replica, restricts replica types to Master and Worker, and mandates that every replica spec includes at least one container named 'xgboost' with a non-empty image.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for JAXJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, replica specs must exist and only use the 'Worker' replica type, every container must have an image, and at least one container must be named 'jax'.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for PaddleJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: it checks the job name is a valid DNS-1035 label, validates the RunPolicy (and its immutability on updates), ensures replica types are only Master or Worker, requires at least one container per replica spec with a non-empty image, and mandates a default container named "paddle".

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for PyTorchJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, replica specs must only use Master or Worker types, the Master replica count must be exactly 1, every replica must contain at least one container named 'pytorch' with an image set, and elastic-policy fields are validated for mutual exclusivity with nprocPerNode.

webhooks.name: connection-notebook.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Notebook create/update requests, parses the opendatahub.io/connections annotation (a comma-separated list of namespace/name secret references), validates that each referenced Secret exists in the Notebook's namespace and that the requesting user has 'get' permission on it via SubjectAccessReview, then injects (or removes) the secrets as envFrom secretRef entries in the first container of the Notebook pod template.

webhooks.name: hardwareprofile-notebook-injector.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts Notebook create/update requests and injects hardware profile settings (resource requests/limits, node selectors, and tolerations) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR into the Notebook pod template. It detects profile changes between old and new objects to decide whether to merge or replace settings, handles profile removal by cleaning up previously applied scheduling and resource configurations, and validates container naming conventions.

webhooks.name: vworkspace.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for Workspace resources (kubeflow.org/v1beta1). On create and update, it fetches the referenced WorkspaceKind to verify it exists, then validates that the selected imageConfig and podConfig IDs are among the allowed values defined in that WorkspaceKind, and that pod template metadata labels and annotations are well-formed.

webhooks.name: vworkspacekind.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for WorkspaceKind CRD objects (kubeflow.org/v1beta1) that enforces structural correctness on create (pod metadata, env vars, request headers, imageConfig/podConfig values, port references, redirect cycles) and on update additionally prevents mutation or removal of imageConfig/podConfig options that are actively used by Workspace instances, and on delete blocks deletion when Workspaces still reference the WorkspaceKind or a protection finalizer is present.
